company.shortDescription: Getcho is a last-mile delivery platform. We connect retailers with last-mile fleets, making sure orders are delivered.
company.description: Getcho is the only fleet layer that uses AI to manage drivers guaranteeing a flawless customer experience.

productsAndServices.description: A platform for booking same-day local deliveries within a 25-mile radius, dispatching couriers to pick up and deliver goods promptly.
productsAndServices.name: Getcho Same-Day Delivery Service

productsAndServices.description: An integration that connects Getcho’s delivery platform with Shopify stores to enable local same-day delivery options directly within the Shopify checkout process.
productsAndServices.name: Getcho Shopify Integration

productsAndServices.description: A platform that manages the entire local delivery process including order verification, courier selection, pickup coordination, delivery monitoring, and confirmation.
productsAndServices.name: Getcho Delivery Management Platform

productsAndServices.description: Tools that provide real-time tracking, communication between couriers, businesses, and recipients, and delivery status updates.
productsAndServices.name: Getcho Courier Communication and Tracking Tools

productsAndServices.description: A service that schedules deliveries based on customer availability and selects the optimal courier fleet balancing speed, cost, and payload requirements.
productsAndServices.name: Getcho Delivery Scheduling and Fleet Selection

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,608,599 to $9,680,527, a 1.46x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 52 (-6 over 90 days) and market heat at 76 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
